paite: Huan Ephraim tanggam ah mi khat a-om a, amin Mikah ahi.
heading: Mikah Milimte
english: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

paite: Ama'n anu kiang ah, "Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat nang a pan lakmang a omte, nang leng na hamsiat leh ka zak mahmah a na gen pen, ngai in, huai dangka ka kiang ah a-om, kei lak ahi,” achi hi. Anu'n, "Ka tapa TOUPA vualzawl in om hen," achi hi.
english: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May Yahweh bless my son!”

paite: Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat anu apekik a, anu'n, "Hiai dangka kei khut mahmah in ka tapa in milim abawlna ding leh milim asunna ding in TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Huaiziak in tu in ka hon pekik ding," achi hi.
english: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to Yahweh from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”

paite: Huchi in huai dangka anu apekik a, anu'n dangka zanih ala a, dangka sekmi apia a, ama'n milim khuakthoh leh sunthohte ana bawl a, huaite Mikah inn ah a-om uhi.
english: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.

paite: Mikah in pathiante inn anei a, ephod leh milimte abawl a, atapa khat asiampu in aseptuamta hi.
english: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

paite: Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mit a dik asakte ahih chiat mai uhi.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

paite: Judah gam Bethlehem mi Judah nam, Levi chi tangval khat, huai ah ava om hi.
english: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.

paite: Huai mi Bethlehem Judah khopi a pan apawt a, omna zong a vak ahi. Avakna lam ah Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung hi.
english: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.

paite: Mikah in akiang ah, "Koi a pan hong pai na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bethlehem Judah mi Levi chi ka hi a, omna mun zong a vak ka hi,” achi hi.
english: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”

paite: Mikah in akiang ah, "Ka pa leh siampu ding in ka kiang ah teng in, kum teng in, dangkasik tang sawm ka hon pe dia, puansilh khat leh nek dingte leng," achi hi. Huchi in Levi chi alutta hi.
english: Micah said to him, “Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food.” So the Levite went in.

paite: Levi chi, huai mi kiang a ten alungkim hi. Huchi in atapa khat bang in huai tangvalpa a-omta hi.
english: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

paite: Mikah in Levi chi aseptuamta a, huchi in tangvalpa asiampu in apangta a, Mikah inn ah atengta hi.
english: Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

paite: Huchi in Mikah in, "Tu in zaw Levi chi ka siampu ding in ka neita hi. TOUPA'N ahon lamzangsak ngei ding, chih ka thei," achi hi.
english: Then Micah said, “Now I know that Yahweh will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”
